summary: Audio subsystem update wrapper: forwards the per-frame float parameter a2 to two audio update routines on the same instance, sub_57E0A0 and sub_57E280, then always returns 1 (true). The wrapped callees carry the actual audio processing; this function is a thin sequencing wrapper in the audio subsystem.

operations.description: Invoke sub_57E0A0 with this instance and the float update parameter a2
Invoke sub_57E280 with this instance and the float update parameter a2
Always return the constant 1, signalling a successful or complete update
